items.prompt: What is the root word of helpful?

options.why: -ful is the suffix, not the root word.
Helper is in the same family, but it is not the root word.
Helpless is in the same family, but it is longer than the root.

hints: The root word is the main part of the word.
Take away the suffix at the end.
What is left when you take off -ful?
items.explanation: The root word is help. The suffix -ful is added to make helpful.

items.prompt: Which word is in the same word family as play?

options.why: Plate starts with pla, but it has nothing to do with playing.
Plan is not about playing.
Place is not about playing.

hints: Words in a family share a root word and a meaning.
Look for a word that has the whole word play in it.
Does the word have something to do with playing?
items.explanation: Player has the root word play in it, and it means someone who plays.

items.prompt: Choose all the words in the friend word family.

options.why: Fried is about cooking, not friends.
Fright means a sudden fear.

hints: A word family shares the same root word.
Look for the whole word friend inside each word.
Check the meaning too. Is it about being a friend?
items.explanation: Friendly, friendship and unfriendly all contain the root word friend, and they are all about friends.

items.prompt: Match each word to its root word.
hints: Take off any prefix or suffix.
What is the main word that is left?
Start with rebuild. Take off re-.
items.explanation: The root word is what is left after you take off the prefix and the suffix, like build in rebuild.

items.prompt: Write the root word of unkindness.
hints: This word has a prefix and a suffix.
Take off un- at the front.
Now take off the suffix at the end.
items.explanation: Un + kind + ness = unkindness. The root word is kind.

items.prompt: An actor is someone who acts. What is a musician?

options.why: A musician is a person.
A musician is a person, not a lesson.
A musician is a person, not a place.

hints: Look at the root word inside musician.
The ending -ian often means a person.
Think of magician: someone who does magic.
items.explanation: Musician comes from music. The ending -ian means a person, so a musician is someone who plays music.

items.prompt: Sort the words into their word families.
hints: Look for the root word inside each word.
Each word has sign, act or light inside it.
Start with lighthouse. Which root word can you see?
items.explanation: Signal, signature and signpost share sign. Action, actor and active share act. Sunlight and lighthouse share light.

items.prompt:
Use a word from the care family.
Please be ___ with the glass vase.
hints: The care family has words ending in -ful, -less and -er.
You need a word that means taking care.
Read the sentence with each care word in the gap.
items.explanation: Careful means full of care. You should be careful with a glass vase.

items.prompt: Use the word family to work out the meaning. What is childhood?

options.why: The ending -hood here does not mean a hat!

options.text: the time when you are a child

options.why: That would be a class or a group.
Childhood is a time of life, not a game.

hints: The root word is child.
The ending -hood can mean a time of life.
Think of the word babyhood.
items.explanation: Childhood means the time of your life when you are a child. The suffix -hood can mean a time or state.

items.prompt: Which word is NOT in the same family as the others?

options.why: Signal comes from sign.
Signature comes from sign: you sign your name.
A signpost is a post that holds signs.

hints: Three of the words are linked by meaning to sign.
Starting with the same letters is not enough.
Which word has nothing to do with signs or signing?
items.explanation: Single starts with sig, but it means one. It has nothing to do with sign, so it is not in the family.

items.prompt:
Use two words from the act family.
The ___ was very ___ on stage, jumping and dancing.
hints: One word names a person. The other describes someone who moves a lot.
Both words start with act.
Start with the person. What do you call someone who acts in a play?
items.explanation: An actor is a person who acts. Active means moving a lot.

items.prompt: Bio means life and graph means writing. Which word means the written story of a person's life?

options.why: Biology is the study of living things.
Biscuit starts with bi, but it is a food!
In bicycle, bi means two wheels.

hints: Look for a word with bio at the start.
Then look for the part that means writing.
Which word has both parts?
items.explanation: Biography is made of bio (life) and graph (writing). It is a written story of a person's life.
